description: Hi! I’m a Grade 12 student at Next Generation School in the UAE. I’m interested in space exploration, technology, AI, robotics, and programming. I enjoy learning new things, solving problems, and developing creative ideas. I’m participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 because I want to use technology to create a meaningful solution. I’m looking for teammates who are interested in coding, research, science, and creative design.
summary: Space Heritage Museum is an interactive digital platform that tells the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our project helps students understand why this equipment was sent into space, what its purpose was, what scientific discoveries it helped make, and what happened to it after its mission ended. The platform includes interactive equipment stories, exploration maps, a mission timeline, pictures, and educational quizzes. Our goal is to turn space history into an interesting learning experience for young people and show that even equipment left behind has an important story to tell.
details:
Our project, Space Heritage Museum, is a digital educational platform that tells the story of NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The website helps students learn about space exploration by showing different pieces of equipment, such as old rovers, scientific instruments, and mission technology. It explains what each piece of equipment was used for, which mission it belonged to, and why it is important to space science.

The platform uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create an interactive and easy-to-use experience. Its main goal is to turn forgotten space equipment into an interesting learning experience for young people.

This project is important because it helps people understand the history of space exploration and appreciate the technology that made scientific discoveries possible.
